description: This file defines React components for displaying and managing subscription plans, including plan selection, comparison, testimonials, and related UI elements for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: RecurringPricing
methods.description: Component displaying recurring plan pricing details, including discounts and billing periods.

methods.name: OneTimePricing
methods.description: Component displaying one-time plan pricing details.

methods.name: ComparePlans
methods.description: Component rendering a comparison table of different subscription plans.

methods.name: formatOneTimePeriod
methods.description: Formats a billing period into a human-readable string for one-time payments.

methods.name: formatRecurringPeriod
methods.description: Formats a billing period into a human-readable string for recurring payments.

methods.name: formatRecurringPeriodShort
methods.description: Provides a short abbreviation for billing periods.

methods.name: getFullPeriod
methods.description: Returns the full name of a billing period.

methods.name: toMonthlyPrice
methods.description: Converts a total price over a billing period into a monthly price.

methods.name: Testimonial
methods.description: Component displaying a user testimonial with avatar and quote.
